chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The greatest defect is to regard that defect (in others) which is present in yourself.
ai.seo_question: What is the greatest defect in criticizing others according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the hypocrisy of criticizing others for faults one possesses oneself, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia tradition of self-accountability (muhasaba). This teaching serves as a practical remedy for spiritual arrogance, urging believers to prioritize internal purification over external judgment. It reflects the broader Islamic ethic of sincerity (ikhlas) in worship and conduct.
